elements.commentary: Naming the fee is the easy half. The harder question for an operator is attribution: 5% on a guest who was already ordering direct is a cost, while 5% on a genuinely new guest is cheap acquisition. Since the guest data comes back to the brand, will operators be able to see which Olo App orders came from net new guests and which from regulars who just found the brand through the app? Without that split the fee looks fine on the statement and nobody knows whether they are paying it on guests they already owned.
